name: edugenie
description: EDUGENIE - Google Gemini Powered Learning Assistant (Production Foundation)

scripts.dev:backend: sh -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; else PYTHONPATH=backend python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; fi'
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: sh -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/pytest ]; then PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/bin/pytest tests; else PYTHONPATH=backend python3 -m pytest tests; fi'
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
